run_single_task: run a single SWE task with the mini swe runner using a bash command prompt
run_batch_tasks: run multiple SWE tasks from a JSONL prompts file and save trajectories to output JSONL
create_environment: create a sandboxed execution environment using local, docker, or modal backends
convert_to_hermes_format: convert internal message history to Hermes trajectory format with XML-tagged tool calls
execute_command: execute a bash command in the selected environment and return output with exit code
